priorities.summary: SQL injection in FortiAnalyzer and FortiManager lets an unauthenticated attacker who can reach the OFTP port execute code or commands via crafted OFTP packets. Affects FortiAnalyzer 7.2-8.0.1 and FortiManager 7.2-8.0.0; Fortinet published the fix on November 10.

Improper input validation in Zoom Workplace for Windows allows an unauthenticated user to escalate privileges via network access. Affects Zoom Workplace 7.1 before 7.1.8; Zoom rates it CVSS 9.6 and fixed it in its November security bulletin ZSB-26023.

A use-after-free in the replication component of MongoDB Server can be triggered by unauthenticated requests when a newly elected primary completes catch-up, crashing the server or, under certain conditions, leading to arbitrary code execution. Affects MongoDB Server 6.0 through 9.0.

model.name: Google Gemini 4 Hydrogen
model.summary: Google's fast execution model for agentic workflows, launched November 12 across AI Studio, the Gemini API, the Gemini app and Search. It scores 51 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at its default thinking level and costs $1.50/$7.50 per million input/output tokens across a 1M-token context window.
